llama_cpp.patch_reason: zenz-v3 GGUF declares tokenizer.ggml.pre=gpt2-small-japanese-char. Upstream rejects the name; the patch maps it to the existing GPT-2 byte-level BPE pre-tokenizer, which is the tokenizer zenz was trained with.
